proposals.before: Xin made Xiu General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan Pavilion, entrusted him as close confidant, and had him gather braves of the six commanderies to more than ten thousand to cut the northern road.
proposals.after: Xin made Li Xiang General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan Pavilion, entrusted him as close confidant, and had him gather braves of the six commanderies to more than ten thousand to cut the northern road.
proposals.reason: The preceding sentence names 李庠, and 廞以庠 appoints that same Li Xiang under Zhao Xin. Xiu misnames him and wrongly suggests Sun Xiu, whose separate 孫秀 episode is s0354. Replace only the erroneous name; preserve all other wording.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 李庠帥妹婿李含、天水任回、上官昌、扶風李攀、始平費他、氐苻成、隗伯等四千騎歸廞。廞以庠為威寇將軍，封陽泉亭侯，委以心膂，使招合六郡壯勇至萬餘人，以斷北道。
